column1: # `dungeon-mode.md §8` fountains. L-Look on a fountain cell prints
# `You see:\na fountain.\n`, then `Will you drink?`, and Y applies the
# low nibble's effect to the selected member. Sub-type 1 is Heal.
# The party stands *on* the fountain, so the relative chooser's Down key
# (`Dir-Here`) reads the party's own cell and facing cannot matter.
# which `dungeon_class_scan` reports as the only `0x51` cell in the
# requires-seed: the party standing on a heal fountain, with a torch

column4: You see: a fountain / Will you drink?
